ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Commercial_Task_Toolkit", OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(altm__alert_stage_type__c, "Reviewed"), OR( ISBLANK(cstk__Reviewed_Comments_html__c), REGEX(cstk__Reviewed_Comments_html__c, "(<[^>]*>|[\\s ])*") ) ), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(altm__alert_stage_type__c, "Reviewed")), NOT(ISBLANK(cstk__Reviewed_Comments_html__c)), NOT(REGEX(cstk__Reviewed_Comments_html__c, "(<[^>]*>|[\\s ])*")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status and Reviewed Comments are inconsistent. Please verify both fields before saving. If Reviewed Comments has text, Status must be Reviewed; if Status is set to Reviewed, a comment in Reviewed Comments is required.
